newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Bullet kills girl, aged eight, in Albanian town.
newsitem.headline: Bullet kills girl, aged eight, in Albanian town.

text.p: A stray bullet killed an eight-year-old girl on Sunday in the Albanian flashpoint town of Vlore, hospital sources said.
They said the child, who was not named, had not been the target of an attack in the southern Adriatic port, where armed rioters have put police and soldiers to flight.
The sources said the bullet either ricocheted off a building or had hit the girl after being fired into the air.
A further 22 people were also treated for wounds at the hospital on Sunday, the sources said.

Vlore was the scene on Friday night of the worst violence in two months of unrest in Albania, Europe's poorest state, following the collapse of dubious pyramid savings schemes which had soaked up many people's life savings.
Up to nine people, three of them civilians, were reported killed in Friday's gun battle between demonstrators and Shik secret policemen.
The Albanian parliament on Sunday declared an immediate state of emergency in response to the uprising in Vlore and a string of southern towns.
